instruction: Query the OQMD database for La-Mn-O ternary compounds (element_set=La,Mn,O AND ntypes=3) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata) and the entry with the lowest delta_e (entry_id/name/composition/delta_e/stability/spacegroup/volume/prototype) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_15.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
